facts.text: Under Austin College's Compass curriculum, undergraduate students are required to complete three January Term (JanTerm) intensive courses and one Applied Learning Experience such as research, an internship, or community-based learning.

sources.title: Academics at Austin College | Sherman, Texas
sources.quote: Experience connections between your liberal arts education and life beyond the classroom, providing pathways to meaningful careers and community participation. One Applied Learning Experience Three January Term courses First-Year Experience
